title.zh: ⚡️彭博社：特朗普为美以选举后可能升级对伊军事行动做准备
title.en: ⚡️彭博社：特朗普为美以选举后可能升级对伊军事行动做准备

current_state.zh: The US is adding a third carrier strike group and 10,000 personnel to the Persian Gulf while Trump hints at resuming strikes on Iran after the November 3 midterms, prompting Iranian retaliation planning and a partial US diplomatic evacuation from Saudi Arabia as Brent crude's year-to-date gain exceeds 80%.
